title: Heuristics are Not Enough: Calibrated and Corrected Caching for Video Diffusion Acceleration
title_zh: 启发式方法并不足够：用于视频扩散加速的校准与修正缓存机制

paragraphs.en: 本文提出了一种新的缓存机制AlignCache，通过校准和修正缓存来改善视频扩散模型的加速和质量。 Feature caching has become a mainstream training-free strategy for accelerating video diffusion models by reusing intermediate outputs across denoising steps. However, existing adaptive methods rely on heuristic difference measures misaligned with actual generation quality, employ a single global threshold that ignores heterogeneous phase dynamics, and never validate their budget estimates against true approximation error, allowing systematic bias to propagate uncorrected. We propose \textbf{AlignCache}, a closed-loop caching framework that directly aligns scheduling decisions with their true influence on the final generated video through three tightly coupled components: (1) phase-adaptive budget routing that partitions the denoising trajectory into structurally distinct phases, each governed by an independent threshold and a staleness-aware guard; (2) closed-loop threshold calibration that exploits counterfactual error measurement at the classifier-free guided output level to adjust decision boundaries online via an EMA feedback loop; and (3) momentum-augmented draft synthesis combining direction-magnitude gated residual extrapolation with anchor-guided unconditional correction. By transforming scheduling from a static risk accumulator into a feedback-driven, self-correcting controller, AlignCache consistently achieves superior acceleration-quality trade-offs across state-of-the-art video generation models. Our code is available at https://github.com/jiangjyjy/AlignCache.
paragraphs.zh: 本文提出了一种名为 AlignCache 的新型缓存机制，通过校准和修正缓存来改善视频扩散模型的加速效果与生成质量。特征缓存已成为一种主流的无训练策略，它通过在去噪步骤中重复利用中间输出，从而加速视频扩散模型。 然而，现有的自适应方法依赖于与实际生成质量不一致的经验性差异度量，采用单一的全局阈值而忽略了异质性阶段动态变化，并且从未将预算估计值与真实的近似误差进行验证，导致系统性偏差持续存在而未被纠正。 我们提出了 \textbf{AlignCache}——一个闭环缓存框架，它通过三个紧密耦合的组件，将调度决策与其对最终生成视频的真实影响直接对齐：(1) 阶段自适应预算路由，它将去噪轨迹划分为结构上不同的阶段，每个阶段由独立的阈值和感知陈旧性的守卫机制控制；(2) 闭环阈值校准，它在无分类器引导输出层利用反事实误差测量，通过 EMA 反馈循环在线调整决策边界；以及 (3) 动量增强草案合成，它将方向-幅度门控残差外推与锚点引导的无条件修正相结合。 通过将调度从静态的风险累积器转变为反馈驱动、自我纠正的控制器，AlignCache 在多种最先进的视频生成模型上始终能实现更优的加速与质量平衡。 我们的代码可在 https://github.com/jiangjyjy/AlignCache 获取。
